acceptanceCriteria: An adoption provider can supply a typed test-run receipt that docs_get returns and docs_coverage counts, labelled supplied.
A legacy-case id from an external export links to a corpus subject, or the gap names why it cannot.
capabilities and the query index report supplied gaps; existing corpora stay byte-identical.
body: V1-1987 (PR #1258, DCP-V1-185..192) delivered supplied gaps, supplied status and manual-case links, but left three #1244 acceptance items: (1) typed test-run receipts beyond the existing test-validity format; (2) linking legacy-case ids from an external MCP export file (only imported manual_case subjects are supported); (3) supplied gaps are not reported in capabilities or the query index. Supplied records must stay labelled supplied and never raise trust (AGENTS.md invariant 3).
title: Adoption providers: typed test-run receipts, external legacy-case ids, and supplied gaps in capabilities and the query index (GitHub #1244 residuals)
